title: Design System: Mohamad Noor-Chowdhury Showcase Hub

scope.note: Per-surface worlds. Tokens in DESIGN.md frontmatter and this sidecar belong only to the Colosseum article (/colosseum, src/views/colosseum.css, scoped under .colosseum-article).

terracotta-ink.purpose: Terracotta text and figures on newsprint.

sage-ink.purpose: Sage text and signs on newsprint.

deep-navy-ink.purpose: Primary text; text on mustard, sage and terracotta fields.

navy-ink-soft.purpose: Running prose and secondary text on newsprint.

pale-on-navy.purpose: Labels on navy fields; running-head links use oklch(0.9 0.02 110).

figure.purpose: Figure strip and grand total numbers; smaller slab figures share the face and tabular numerals.

title.purpose: Era names, pain points, path names, board head (26 to 30px).

lead.purpose: First paragraph of each chapter page.

label.purpose: Running head, bylines, notes, legends, table heads.

shadows.name: column-hairline
shadows.purpose: Box-score column divider on navy. A rule, not elevation; the world has no shadows.

motion.name: ease-print
motion.purpose: The single easing for all arrivals.

motion.name: plate-register
motion.purpose: Cover emblem plates snap from offset into register.

motion.name: roundel-stamp
motion.purpose: Price roundel stamps onto the cover.

motion.name: opener-roll
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0), 900ms; headline 600 to 800ms after 250ms
motion.purpose: Chapter ink page rolls on left to right.

motion.name: tally
motion.purpose: Figures count to their printed value on view.

motion.name: bar-fill
motion.purpose: Revenue bars fill from the left.

motion.name: board-lines
motion.purpose: Price board items arrive in order.

motion.name: cover-broadcast
motion.value: arcs 2400ms loop from 1400ms; cloud drift 6s alternate
motion.purpose: Runs only while the cover is on screen.

narrative.overview:
This hub has no single house style. PRODUCT.md commits each article to a design that serves its subject, so every surface below owns its world and its stylesheet. A new surface does not inherit another surface's tokens; it either extends the world it belongs to or earns its own.

The Colosseum article is a 1970s stadium game-day program. Four flat inks chosen by the author (navy #2D3C59, sage #94A378, mustard #E5BA41, terracotta #D1855C) print onto sage-washed newsprint. A mustard cover carries a slab-serif title and a flat four-ink emblem of the arena with a cloud above it; a navy box-score line lists four headline numbers; each chapter opens on a full-width page printed in one ink, and reading settles back onto newsprint with lineup tables, square ink-ruled boxes and a concession price board. It is dense, warm and printed, the opposite of a dark streaming-tech long read with glow and glass.
keyCharacteristics: Four author-pinned inks, printed flat; every other color is derived from them.
Sage-washed newsprint ground, with a second sheet one step down for alternating bands.
Alfa Slab One for display and every big number, Libre Franklin for heads, labels and tables, Source Serif 4 for reading.
Square corners and solid ink rules; no shadows, no blurs, no blended gradients.
Motion reads as printing: plates snap into register, ink pages roll on, figures tally up.

rules.name: The Four Inks Rule
rules.body: Every field, rule and emblem fill is one of the four inks, newsprint, or a ramp step derived from them. No other hue enters the page.

rules.name: The Readable Ink Rule
rules.body: Terracotta and sage print as fields; when they carry text or figures on newsprint they switch to Terracotta Ink and Sage Ink. Never set a bare terracotta or sage number on paper.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: Inks are printed flat. The only patterned fill is the diagonal hatch on the "unknown" bar, a print screen in sage at full and half strength; it is a hatch, not a blend.

rules.name: The Slab Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every figure the reader is meant to remember is set in Alfa Slab One with tabular numerals. Body copy never carries a headline number in the serif.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Slab for names and numbers, Franklin for structure, serif for argument. A heading is never set in the reading serif, and prose is never set in Franklin.

rules.name: The Printed Not Lifted Rule
rules.body: Separate things with a field of ink, a solid rule or the second sheet, never with a shadow.

dos: Do print every field in one of the four inks or newsprint, and derive any new tone from those inks in OKLCH.
Do switch to Terracotta Ink or Sage Ink whenever those hues carry text or numbers on newsprint.
Do set every headline number in Alfa Slab One with tabular numerals.
Do frame boxes with a 2px navy rule at 0 radius, and open lists and fact rows with a 6px navy top rule.
Do keep the opener's second-line device: navy band on sage and terracotta, terracotta band on mustard, mustard type on navy.
Do draw emblems as flat filled shapes in the inks, using the three per-opener ink slots.
Do keep content visible without script and let reduced motion land on the final state.
donts: Don't use drop shadows, glows, glass or backdrop blur.
Don't blend inks in gradients; a print hatch or a functional scroll fade is the limit.
Don't round boxes, strips, tables or fields.
Don't add hues outside the four inks, and don't change the author's four pins.
Don't set prose in Franklin or headings in the reading serif.
Don't apply these tokens to another surface in the hub; each surface keeps its own world.
